description: Update remote configuration — Updates an existing remote with new parameter values.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

name.description: Name of the remote configuration to update.

opt.description: Optional JSON object controlling update behaviour (e.g. `obscure`, `continue`).

parameters.description: JSON object of configuration key/value pairs to apply to the remote.

name: config_update
